name: Koko wa Madoromi no Soko
source:
Yasunari Adachi is an ordinary 3rd year high schooler. Recently he's been getting bullied and doesn't really socialize but, online he's very friendly. And he loves his friend, who is a guy. 

Then along comes a young guy who goes by Kami. Rumors spread of a ghost that appears in their online game, resulting in a mysterious death....... 

An original BL visual sound novel where dreams and reality collide.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE111265.html]DLsite English[/url]]
